name: Night of Dust
source:
Thrown into a war they never asked for, Ellis must rely on courage, wits, and the strength of friends. Dylan, Sammy, and Jaehrim risk everything, leaving Ellis to face grief, heartbreak, and the cost of being a hero. 

Every battle is personal, every moment could be the last...

[From [url=https://dontouchglazz.itch.io/night-of-dust]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃利斯被卷入一场他们从未要求的战争，他必须依靠勇气、智慧和朋友的力量。迪伦、萨米和贾里姆冒着一切风险，让埃利斯面临悲伤、心碎和成为英雄的代价。

每场战斗都是个人的，每一刻都可能是最后……

[来自[url=https://dontouchglazz.itch.io/night-of-dust]Itch.io[/url]]
